title: The second half of the stated goal has never been run
the_question: 'you sure this is the smartest approach?' (sixth time)
the_answer: no. There is a structural asymmetry nobody named in 94 rounds:

the_asymmetry.stated_goal: 'totally solve any computer use, literally anything on the computer, and this includes the most advanced software engineering capabilities'
the_asymmetry.computer_use_half: measured every round for 94 rounds -- 130 tasks, dozens of runs, ~10 governance records
the_asymmetry.software_engineering_half: canonical/swe_kernel/ = 39 modules, a 1525-line closed-loop repository solver with localise/patch/verify/backtrack ... and ZERO benchmark runs, ever. It has produced no diffs, no patches and no pass@1.
the_asymmetry.reading: the goal is conjunctive. Half of it has never once been executed. Every 'smartest approach' answer I gave was about the half that was already instrumented, because that is where the instruments were.

what_was_run_instead.the_artifact_was_stale: built 58c0eb74 (round 40); recompute gives a different digest than the stored artifact. The self-verifying compiled model could not reproduce itself.
what_was_run_instead.after_recompile: 33/33 PASS -- digest 908bedbb, 443 capabilities, 149 bound, 294 receipt-backed, 26 engines, 312 knowledge docs, 1990 source modules, 6791 research records, 2360 routing tokens, 0 weights
what_was_run_instead.caveat_kept_verbatim: AUTHORITY NONE -- SANDBOX MEASUREMENT, NOT INDEPENDENT VERIFICATION

what_this_proves: the repository contains a compiled, digest-stable, self-verifying zero-weight model whose own verifier passes 33/33 and was, until this round, unrun and stale. The instruments were not missing. They were unplugged (r93) or unrun (r95).

the_next_gate_that_matters.status: exists, has never been executed against a benchmark
the_next_gate_that_matters.the_measurement: a sealed benchmark instance: apply a hidden defect, hand it the goal, count tests that pass afterwards. Any live repo is a valid instance because the repo owns real tests.
the_next_gate_that_matters.why_it_is_the_smartest_next_step: it is the OTHER HALF of the stated goal, it requires no external model, it can be scored by a real oracle (the repo's own test suite), and every prior round's instruments (page grounding, router, inducer) are irrelevant to it -- which is exactly why it was never done.

the_lesson.statement: optimisation follows instrumentation. A part of the goal with no instrument will not be worked on, no matter how often it is stated, because every round ends by reading a number and the uninstrumented half produces none.
the_lesson.the_fix: the software-engineering half needs a benchmark entry before it needs a single improvement.
